title: LOST 0-2, STILL PROMOTED: RONALDO'S CLUB IS HEADING TO SERIE B
description:
A viral Ronaldo wonder goal got 257,000 likes. The fact check says it's AI.

Ronaldo is an investor in Inter de Limeira, and the maths got strange. They lost nil-two to Ferroviaria, yet went up on a one-goal margin. Their first Serie B place in thirty-five years.

At fifty, Ronaldo also runs a beach club with a twenty-five-thousand square-metre artificial beach. Tennis memberships cost 1.15 million reais each. Serve, volley, or remortgage. His charity auction on Tuesday offers a tennis game with Ronaldo himself.

He sold Cruzeiro. He sold Valladolid. Now he is investing in another club. Old habits.

Be honest: did the AI goal fool you? Yes or no in the comments.
